name: Pankaj Manchanda
headline: Founder-Operator and Operations Leader for Scale, Margin Improvement, AML Discipline and Practical AI Adoption
positioning: Founder-operator and operations leader with 26+ years of experience turning strategy into execution across regulated FinTech, e-commerce, real estate, BPO, technology and international business environments. Known for aligning teams, building operating systems, improving margins and creating the rhythm needed to scale.
availability: Available for Founder's Office, Director of Operations, Head of Operations, AML/Compliance Operations and AI-enabled Operations Transformation roles.
summary: Hands-on founder's office style operator who can sit close to leadership, understand the business direction and convert broad priorities into clear execution across teams, vendors, systems and customers.

Strong at seeing the bigger picture, then breaking it into the operating details that matter: ownership, cadence, measurement, cost leakage, process gaps and the team behaviors needed to move faster without losing control.

Led regulated FinTech operations, built BSA/AML and KYC workflows from the ground up, scaled e-commerce operations to 55,000+ annual orders and improved margins through BPO redesign, automation and tighter operating discipline.

Brings practical AI exposure through LLM workflows, n8n, Make, Replit, Bolt and API-based automation, with a focus on reducing manual work, improving reporting and helping teams adopt tools in a realistic way.
